flow.name: patient-sys-api-main
flow.doc:description: Receives /api/* requests, validates them against the RAML and routes them to an operation flow

http:listener.doc:name: Listener /api/*
http:listener.doc:description: Accepts patient record requests; every response carries X-Correlation-ID

flow-ref.name: start-request-context
flow-ref.doc:name: Start request context
flow-ref.doc:description: Captures the correlation ID and start time and logs the incoming request

apikit:router.doc:name: APIkit router
apikit:router.doc:description: Rejects requests that do not match the spec and dispatches the rest

flow-ref.name: log-response-sent
flow-ref.doc:name: Log response sent
flow-ref.doc:description: Logs the response status and request duration

flow.name: post:\patients:application\json:patient-sys-api-config
flow.doc:name: POST /patients
flow.doc:description: Stores a new patient record and returns it with its generated ID

flow-ref.name: insert-patient
flow-ref.doc:name: Insert patient
flow-ref.doc:description: Inserts the record; a duplicate identity raises APP:DUPLICATE_PATIENT

set-variable.doc:name: Location header
set-variable.doc:description: Points the Location header at the new patient resource

flow.name: get:\patients:patient-sys-api-config
flow.doc:name: GET /patients
flow.doc:description: Returns the records with exactly the given family name

set-variable.doc:name: Family name
set-variable.doc:description: Reads the family name from the query string (not logged)

flow-ref.name: find-patients-by-family-name
flow-ref.doc:name: Find patients
flow-ref.doc:description: Selects the matching records; none gives an empty array

set-variable.doc:name: Patient ID
set-variable.doc:description: Reads the patient ID from the URI

flow-ref.name: find-patient-by-id
flow-ref.doc:name: Find patient
flow-ref.doc:description: Selects the record; an unknown ID raises APP:PATIENT_NOT_FOUND
